install: set -euo pipefail; if ! command -v stockfish >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ ! -x /usr/games/stockfish ]; then sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y stockfish; fi; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PATH="/usr/games:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="/usr/games:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc; export PATH="/usr/games:$PATH"; [ -d venv ] || python3 -m venv venv; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv pip install --python venv/bin/python -e '.[dev]'; else venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-input --upgrade pip && venv/bin/pip install --no-input -e '.[dev]'; fi
